kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتبحبح (form IIq)
# أَتَبَحْبَحُ (ʔatabaḥbaḥu) /ʔa.ta.baħ.ba.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# أُتَبَحْبَحُ (ʔutabaḥbaḥu) /ʔu.ta.baħ.ba.ħu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# أَتَبَحْبَحَ (ʔatabaḥbaḥa) /ʔa.ta.baħ.ba.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# أُتَبَحْب
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
